params.description: Domicile to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.

params.name: exchangeCountry
params.description: Exchange country to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.

params.name: exchangeId

params.description: Specifies the country to filter results on. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes. The availability of data depends on the specific data points and investments queried

items.docs:
The Aggregates – Residual Risk And Return Sensitivity package provides measures of the excess returns of investment in a stock, along with its volatility and relative performance aggregated by industry classification, using Morningstar’s Morningstar Global Equity Classification Structure, to give industry-wide averages on a country-by-country basis to use to benchmark a company’s financial performance relative to other companies in that industry, industry group, or sector.
The package contains
